scope: Additive Metal Pants L1-18 Minion Prince barrier audit, separating official protection from pinned level values and unresolved damage order.
game_version: Official February 2025 Equipment release, November 2025 TH18 Equipment HP rebalance; secondary claimed client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: A new Update is here!
facts: Metal Pants is permanent Common Minion Prince Equipment with levels 1-18.
It creates a temporary protective barrier that blocks some damage while active.
sources.limitations: The announcement does not publish percentage, duration, damage-origin eligibility, stacking, recovery or tick order.

sources.title: TOWN HALL 18 Crash Lands! - Update
facts: All Minion Prince Equipment gained an additional 500 HP during the TH18 defensive rebalance.
sources.limitations: It does not define barrier mitigation or Hero HP stacking order.

sources.title: The February 2025 update is here!
facts: Activation creates a protective barrier that reduces incoming damage.
sources.limitations: No current per-level effect values, damage origin, barrier hit order or expiry phase are given.

sources.title: Metal Pants — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: The dated L1-18 Prince HP 850-1700 and ore-cost table matches the pinned raw fields.
The page describes temporary damage reduction.
sources.limitations: The public table omits barrier percentages, duration and recovery values.

sources.title: Pinned Metal Pants Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: The pinned record has active ability, 9-15 second duration, 46-70 percent incoming damage reduction, and Prince HP/recovery bonuses.
sources.limitations: Current percentage/duration/recovery continuity and exact damage-resolution contract are not established.

sources.title: Metal Pants
sources.version: page revision and game build not pinned
facts: The public page repeats the pinned 9-15 second, 46-70 percent and recovery series and describes temporary protection from damage of any type.
sources.limitations: No pinned build or revision establishes current effect continuity; the broad damage-origin claim has no authoritative deterministic contract.

observations.note: Current dated table corroborates HP only; percentage, duration and recovery remain historical pinned fields.

derivations.result: Retain all 18 pinned fields as data-only
derivations.method: Cross-check the immutable payload's Prince HP and ore rows with the dated client-file table; keep effect values marked historical.

derivations.result: Record temporary Prince incoming-damage mitigation without a Core actor
derivations.method: Use the official release and dated launch report for active barrier identity; do not infer percentage continuity, origin filtering or tick phase.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply the pinned 46-70 percent reduction to every damage origin
rejected_inferences.reason: The official note says some damage while active, without defining traps, death effects, poison, Monolith percentage damage or other origin handling.

rejected_inferences.rule: Start duration on the command effective tick and expire before damage on the final tick
rejected_inferences.reason: Activation, damage and expiry phase ordering is undocumented.

rejected_inferences.rule: Recover the pinned HP amount at activation before maximum-HP increase
rejected_inferences.reason: The pinned recovery field has no current dated verification or heal-cap order.

rejected_inferences.rule: Stack barrier multiplicatively with Dragon Duke trap mitigation or other protection
rejected_inferences.reason: Metal Pants is Prince-only and no source defines interactions with simultaneous modifiers.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the Fandom table as current client evidence
rejected_inferences.reason: Its exact revision and game build were not pinned.

items: current duration, reduction and recovery series
barrier activation, visual onset, last protected tick and expiry
eligible incoming damage origins and order with shields, traps, poison, Monolith and death effects
reduction arithmetic, rounding, minimum damage and HP cap
Prince HP bonus and recovery stacking with other Equipment, Pets and spells
defender use and Hero Banner interactions
Viewer barrier art and overlay, controls, snapshot, replay and RL activation

conclusion: Metal Pants L1-18 remains partial and catalogue-only. Official sources establish permanent active Prince protection, and a dated table confirms Hero HP bonuses; current barrier values and damage/tick ordering remain unresolved.
